sentences.en: In the white-hot debate over who controls what happens in America's schools, a new battleground has emerged.
sentences.zh: 在关于谁来控制美国学校内部事务的激烈争论中，一个新的战场已经出现。

sentences.en: The books that sit on library shelves.
sentences.zh: 图书馆书架上的那些书。

sentences.en: Today, my colleague, Alexandra Alter, with the story of what happened when parents in one town tried to remove a handful of books that they said were explicit
sentences.zh: 今天，我的同事亚历山大·奥尔特（Alexandra Alter）将为我们讲述这样一个故事：当一个小镇的父母试图移除他们认为露骨

sentences.en: and sexually inappropriate and the messy battle that ensued.
sentences.zh: 且色情不当的几本书时，发生了一场怎样的混乱争端。

sentences.en: It's Wednesday, December 7th.
sentences.zh: 今天是12月7日，星期三。

sentences.en: Alexandra, tell me about Martha Hickson.
sentences.zh: 亚历山大，跟我讲讲玛莎·希ickson（Martha Hickson）的故事吧。

sentences.en: Martha Hickson is a high school librarian in Annandale, New Jersey, which is a small town near the Pennsylvania border.
sentences.zh: 玛莎·希克森是新泽西州安嫩代尔一所高中的图书管理员，那是一个靠近宾夕法尼亚州边界的小镇。

sentences.en: And when I spoke to Martha on the phone, she told me she's been a librarian for about 18 years now.
sentences.zh: 当我通过电话与玛莎交谈时，她告诉我她当图书管理员已经大约18年了。

sentences.en: So becoming a librarian was not always my life plan.
sentences.zh: 所以，成为一名图书管理员并不是我最初的人生规划。

sentences.en: The first half of my career, I was in corporate public relations for AT&T.
sentences.zh: 在我职业生涯的前半段，我从事的是美国电话电报公司（AT&T）的企业公关工作。

sentences.en: And after the events of September 11th, I did kind of an inventory of my life.
sentences.zh: 911事件发生后，我对自己的生活做了一番盘点。

sentences.en: And I had always had in the back of my mind that I would like to teach and work with kids.
sentences.zh: 我的心底一直有个想法，那就是我想教书并和孩子们一起工作。

sentences.en: I wasn't able to have kids of my own, and I really felt that was a piece of my life that was missing.
sentences.zh: 我没能拥有自己的孩子，我真的觉得那是生命中缺失的一部分。

sentences.en: And so I looked into librarianship.
sentences.zh: 于是我了解了图书馆学。

sentences.en: And one of the things I love about being in a library, especially a school library, is it's kind of a refuge for kids.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢身处图书馆的原因之一，尤其是学校图书馆，在于它是孩子们的避难所。

sentences.en: She's somebody who sees her library as a resource for her community, not just for what they read, but as kind of a sanctuary for people.
sentences.zh: 她把自己的图书馆视为社区的资源，不仅提供阅读材料，更像是人们的心灵圣殿。

sentences.en: You don't have to read if you don't want to when you come in the library.
sentences.zh: 当你走进图书馆时，如果你不想读书，也可以不读。

sentences.en: I just want you to relax and feel comfortable.
sentences.zh: 我只希望你放松并感到舒适。

sentences.en: But, you know, on the literary side too, reading is something that they can enjoy for a lifetime.
sentences.zh: 但你知道，在文学层面上，阅读也是他们可以终生享受的事情。

sentences.en: And I really wanted to help kids find that enjoyment.
sentences.zh: 我真的很想帮助孩子们找到这种乐趣。

sentences.en: And I think another thing that librarians provide is, you know, a reflection of the communities that they're serving, can you tell us a little bit about your school community
sentences.zh: 我认为图书馆员提供的另一个东西，就是他们所服务的社区的倒影，你能跟我们讲讲你们的学校社区

sentences.en: and what the students are like?
sentences.zh: 以及学生们是什么样的吗？

sentences.en: So it's been very interesting to see the school community evolve in terms of its demographics.
sentences.zh: 所以，看到学校社区在人口结构上的演变，是一件非常有趣的事。

sentences.en: We have definitely seen a growth in our diversity in terms of people of color.
sentences.zh: 我们确实看到了有色人种学生在多样性上的增长。

sentences.en: I've also seen more students who are describing themselves as somewhere on the LGBTQ spectrum.
sentences.zh: 我也看到越来越多的学生将自己描述为处于LGBTQ光谱上的某个位置。

sentences.en: My goal is for every kid that walks in the door to be able to find themselves on the shelves.
sentences.zh: 我的目标是让每一个走进大门的孩子都能在书架上找到他们自己。

sentences.en: So as the school librarian, it's Martha's job to choose the books.
sentences.zh: 因此，作为学校的图书管理员，挑选书籍是玛莎的工作。

sentences.en: And like many librarians who are curating collections, she looks at a wide number of sources and factors when she's choosing which books to include.
sentences.zh: 就像许多正在精心挑选藏书的图书管理员一样，她在选择哪些书入选时会参考大量的来源和因素。

sentences.en: She has a master's in library science, so she's studied this.
sentences.zh: 她拥有图书馆学硕士学位，所以她对此进行过专门研究。

sentences.en: And then she consults places like the American Library Association.
sentences.zh: 然后她会咨询像美国图书馆协会（American Library Association）这样的机构。

sentences.en: She looks at book reviews.
sentences.zh: 她会查看图书评论。

sentences.en: And she's also thinking about maybe some adult books that teenagers who have a wider range of interests might want to see.
sentences.zh: 她还会考虑一些可能适合兴趣更广泛的青少年的成人读物。

sentences.en: So really, it's her responsibility to choose what's in the library.
sentences.zh: 所以，选择图书馆里有什么书确实是她的责任。

sentences.en: So during the height of COVID, the library had been shut.
sentences.zh: 所以在新冠疫情最严重的时候，图书馆曾被迫关闭。

sentences.en: And so Martha was really excited to return to a full school year when everything would be back to normal.
sentences.zh: 因此，当一切恢复正常、能够迎来完整的一个学年时，玛莎感到非常兴奋。

sentences.en: But then...
sentences.zh: 但是随后……

sentences.en: It was a typical day in the library.
sentences.zh: 那是图书馆里极其平常的一天。

sentences.en: Just after school started in the fall of 2021.
sentences.zh: 就在2021年秋季开学后不久。

sentences.en: At noontime, I was sitting right here, right here.
sentences.zh: 正午时分，我正坐在这里，就坐在这个地方。

sentences.en: Her world was turned completely upside down.
sentences.zh: 她的世界彻底天翻地覆了。

sentences.en: And it was a Tuesday.
sentences.zh: 那是星期二。

sentences.en: And my principal walked in and said that he had a rumor that there was going to be a complaint about a book at that evening's board meeting.
sentences.zh: 我的校长走了进来，说他听到一个小道消息，称当天晚上的校董会会议上会有人对某本书提出投诉。

sentences.en: And I went home that night.
sentences.zh: 那天晚上我回家了。

sentences.en: And the board meeting starts at 7 o'clock.
sentences.zh: 校董会会议在7点开始。

sentences.en: It was going to be live streamed, as they typically are these days.
sentences.zh: 和现在的惯例一样，会议将进行网络直播。

sentences.en: And instead of watching Jeopardy, as I usually do at 7, and my husband and I...
sentences.zh: 我没有像往常7点那样去看《危险边缘》（Jeopardy），我和我丈夫……

sentences.en: You know, I told my husband, oh, this weird thing happened.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，我跟我丈夫说，哦，发生了一件怪事。

sentences.en: Let's watch the board meeting.
sentences.zh: 我们来看校董会会议吧。

sentences.en: The North 104 East Regional High School District of Board of Ed meeting on Tuesday, September 28, 2021, is now called to order.
sentences.zh: 北104东区高级中学校区教育委员会于2021年9月28日星期二召开的会议现在正式开始。

sentences.en: And the usual boring board business began for about an hour.
sentences.zh: 随后，通常那种枯燥的校董会事务持续了大约一个小时。

sentences.en: They went through their usual agenda.
sentences.zh: 他们按部就班地完成了常规议程。

sentences.en: Now it's an opportunity for public comment.
sentences.zh: 现在是公众发言的时间。

sentences.en: And then came the time for public comments.
sentences.zh: 然后就到了公众评论的环节。

sentences.zh: 吉娜·德卢琴特（Gina DeLucent），黎巴嫩镇。

sentences.zh: 接着一位家长站了起来。

sentences.en: They had just cherry-picked these words and passages out of the books, completely stripped them of context, and served them up on a platter and said, isn't this awful?
sentences.zh: 他们只是从书中精挑细选了这些词汇和段落，完全脱离了上下文，然后把它们端上台面说，这难道不恶心吗？

sentences.en: Both of these books are labeled as adult reading levels.
sentences.zh: 这两本书都被标记为成人阅读级别。

sentences.zh: 然而我16岁的儿子却能借到它们。

sentences.zh: 接着她开始把矛头指向我。

sentences.en: As a matter of fact,
sentences.zh: 事实上，

sentences.en: Martha Hickson, our school librarian, remarked to my son as he was checking out the books, quote,
sentences.zh: 我们的学校图书管理员玛莎·希克森，在我儿子借书时对他说过这样的话，引述如下：

sentences.en: I love that book, and whoever wants to read it has very good taste, end quote.
sentences.zh: “我喜欢那本书，谁想读它说明谁的品味很好，”引述结束。

sentences.en: How dare I check out, you know, this book to her son.
sentences.zh: 她怎么敢把这本书借给她儿子。

sentences.en: Explain to me how this perversion enriches or benefits the young minds of our students or anyone for that matter.
sentences.zh: 请跟我解释一下，这种变态行为如何丰富或造福了我们学生乃至任何人的年轻心灵？

sentences.en: On the contrary, this amounts to an effort to groom our kids to make them more willing to participate in the heinous acts described in these books.
sentences.zh: 恰恰相反，这相当于试图对我们的孩子们进行“培育”（groom），让他们更愿意参与这些书中描述的令人发指的行为。

sentences.en: And in the process of doing that, she labeled me
sentences.zh: 在这个过程中，她给我贴上了

sentences.en: a pedophile, pornographer, and groomer of children.
sentences.zh: 恋童癖、色情狂和儿童诱拐者的标签。

sentences.en: It grooms them to accept the inappropriate advances of an adult.
sentences.zh: 这会促使他们接受成年人不恰当的接近。

sentences.en: Those not familiar with pedophilia methodology need to understand what grooming is.
sentences.zh: 那些不熟悉恋童癖手法的人需要明白什么是“培育”（grooming）。

sentences.en: Those responsible for this disgusting and material in our school should be required to step down, investigate it, and charge accordingly.
sentences.zh: 那些应对我们学校里这些令人作呕的材料负责的人，应该被要求辞职、接受调查并受到相应的指控。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。

sentences.zh: 你经常听到这样一句话，你知道的，我的下巴都快惊掉了。

sentences.en: My jaw literally did drop.
sentences.zh: 我的下巴真的掉下来了。

sentences.en: I was like, I looked like a fish with my mouth open.
sentences.zh: 我当时就像一条张着嘴的鱼。

sentences.en: I couldn't believe what I was hearing.
sentences.zh: 我简直不敢相信自己的耳朵。

sentences.en: Why is this being jammed down our children's throats in the name of peace, equality, and equity?
sentences.zh: 凭什么以和平、平等和公平的名义，把这些东西硬塞进我们孩子的喉咙里？

sentences.en: This needs to end today.
sentences.zh: 这一切今天必须结束。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。

sentences.en: And then several other parents got up to reiterate their concerns about all things library and librarian.
sentences.zh: 随后，其他几位家长也站起来，重申他们对所有与图书馆和图书管理员相关的事物的担忧。

sentences.en: I could not look at those pictures.
sentences.zh: 我根本没法看那些图片。

sentences.en: We imprison the pedophiles and be teaching not to our children?
sentences.zh: 我们把恋童癖关进监狱，难道还要在教育中向我们的孩子展示这些吗？

sentences.en: Men, we are here now.
sentences.zh: 各位，我们现在就在这里。

sentences.en: We are not going to stand here to let this happen.
sentences.zh: 我们绝不会站在这里任由这种事发生。

sentences.en: It was definitely a what the hell moment and did we really just hear that and oh my God, I can't believe it.
sentences.zh: 这绝对是一个“搞什么鬼”的时刻，我们真的刚刚听到了那些话吗？天哪，我简直不敢相信。

sentences.en: And this started making the rounds on social media too.
sentences.zh: 这件事也开始在社交媒体上流传开来。

sentences.en: It was humiliating.
sentences.zh: 这太令人羞辱了。

sentences.en: So what exactly had just happened?
sentences.zh: 那么，刚才到底发生了什么？

sentences.en: So this seemed to come out of nowhere for Martha and she was really blindsided by it.
sentences.zh: 所以这事对玛莎来说似乎是凭空出现的一样，她真的被打了个措手不及。

sentences.en: But the debate that happened in Annandale is something that we've been seeing happening in school districts all over the country and it's not come out of nowhere.
sentences.zh: 但发生在安嫩代尔的这场争论，正是我们在全国各地学区看到正在发生的事情，它并非凭空产生。

sentences.en: Explain that.
sentences.zh: 请解释一下这一点。

sentences.en: So as you know, during the pandemic, schools were shut down across the country and millions of kids had to learn at home.
sentences.zh: 如你所知，在疫情期间，全国各地的学校都关闭了，数百万的孩子不得不留在家中学习。

sentences.en: And a lot of parents were really upset about COVID policies, school closures, but also mask mandates.
sentences.zh: 许多家长对防疫政策、学校关闭以及口罩强制令感到非常不满。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And we started to see parents forming grassroots organizations and teaming up to oppose COVID restrictions.
sentences.zh: 我们开始看到家长们组建基层组织，并联合起来反对防疫限制措施。

sentences.en: And from there, a lot of the parents in these groups started paying closer attention to what was being taught in school curriculuMs.
sentences.zh: 从那以后，这些团体中的许多家长开始更加密切地关注学校课程中教授的内容。

sentences.en: And they were upset about things like how schools were teaching about race and gender and sexuality.
sentences.zh: 他们对学校如何教授种族、性别和性取向等问题感到不满。

sentences.en: And we saw these groups starting to coordinate with one another and it's really kind of coalesced into a pretty widespread national movement with a lot of support
sentences.zh: 我们看到这些团体开始互相协调，这实际上已经凝聚成了一个相当广泛的全国性运动，得到了许多保守派捐助者和政治人物的支持，

sentences.en: from conservative donors and politicians that defines itself as the parental rights movement.
sentences.zh: 该运动将自己定义为“家长权利运动”（parental rights movement）。

sentences.en: And in the last few months, especially in the last year, we've seen a lot of these organizations turn their focus to books.
sentences.zh: 在过去的几个月里，尤其是过去的一年里，我们看到许多这样的组织将重点转向了书籍。

sentences.en: What books are in the library?
sentences.zh: 图书馆里有哪些书？

sentences.en: What books are appropriate for students?
sentences.zh: 哪些书适合学生阅读？

sentences.en: And they found really effective tactics that they are sharing with one another.
sentences.zh: 他们找到了非常有效的策略，并在彼此之间分享。

sentences.en: Some groups have lists of books that they post online with excerpts of passages that they see as explicit or problematic.
sentences.zh: 一些团体在网上发布书单，其中附有他们认为露骨或有问题的段落摘录。

sentences.en: Some of the groups urge their members to go to school board meetings and read excerpts of these books aloud and kind of make a big scene.
sentences.zh: 一些组织敦促其成员前往学校董事会会议，大声朗读这些书的摘录，并大闹一番。

sentences.en: And, you know, that's pretty similar to what happened in Annandale.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，这和发生在安嫩代尔的情况非常相似。

sentences.en: The books that parents complained about in Annandale are the same ones that we're seeing getting objected to across the country right now.
sentences.zh: 家长们在安嫩代尔抱怨的书籍，正是我们现在看到在全国各地遭到反对的那些书籍。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: So tell me about these books that are being cited over and over again, especially in meetings like the one in Annandale.
sentences.zh: 那么，跟我讲讲这些被一遍又一遍引用的书籍，特别是在像安嫩代尔那样激烈的会议上提到的书。

sentences.en: Well, there are quite a few of them, but one that we see getting challenged over and over again is a title called
sentences.zh: 嗯，这样的书有不少，但其中一本屡屡遭到质疑的书名为

sentences.en: This Book is Gay.
sentences.zh: 《这本书是同性恋》（This Book is Gay）。

sentences.en: It's sort of a guidebook for coming out and embracing your sexual identity, and it's written in a very casual manner, and it's geared towards young adults.
sentences.zh: 它有点像一本关于出柜和拥抱自己性取向的指南，行文非常随性，主要面向年轻人。

sentences.en: Another one that's been challenged all over the place is Gender Queer.
sentences.zh: 另一本到处受到质疑的书是《性别酷儿》。

sentences.en: It's a memoir and a graphic novel that explores the author's experience of being non-binary.
